headline: Sep 11 · The four-day “missing lead” hunt was a bug in the watchdog, not the funnel — Mary Grossman’s email had been sitting in the inbox since Sep 6 under a different subject line, and the alert re-fired three hours after being cleared. What survives all three diagnoses: she asked for a call today, and today has arrived. Meanwhile the CRM spend sync has failed three hours straight and the Claude API org is out of credits. Compliance 0/7, day 15.

spotlight.title: Today is the day Mary Grossman asked to be called — and there are now two calendar invites for it
spotlight.detail: Mary Grossman (NV, lead L-MTQ3VBRQ-BC, +1 805 302 2655, grossmanmary885@gmail.com) came in off the $300 Plan on Sep 6 and asked for a callback around Sep 11. That is today. Two invites went on the calendar last night: “confirm her time before 6:45 PM PT” (9:30 PM IST today) and “CALL MARY GROSSMAN — real lead, call by hand” (7:15 AM IST tomorrow). She is the only real prospect on the desk and she has been reachable for five days. The call to make first is not technical: compliance is 0/7 and NV sits outside licensed area, so decide call / refer / hold in writing before her window closes.

spotlight.title: The missing lead was never missing — the watchdog was searching for the wrong subject line, then re-raised the alarm it had just cleared
spotlight.detail: At 14:10Z the watchdog cleared itself: all 3 real Meta leads did reach the inbox. Mary’s arrived on Sep 6 under “[Lead 80] Mary Grossman…” instead of “NEW LEAD CAPTURED…”, and the check only matched that one exact phrase — so it alarmed hourly for roughly 20 hours against a lead that was always there. Two engineering diagnoses (form→sheet wiring, then an alert-suppression bug) were spent on a monitoring defect. Worse: at 17:06Z the same watchdog re-published the identical “1 of 3 missing, check the Google Sheet” alert, three hours after clearing it — it has no memory of its own correction. Fix the lead-matching step to search the full inbox, and make a cleared alert stay cleared.

spotlight.title: The autonomous stack is losing both its brain and its measurement in the same night
spotlight.detail: Two independent outages landed after the PM brief. (1) 15:55Z — Claude API access disabled: the Oraya org is out of usage credits, the same failure as Aug 23. (2) 22:33Z, 23:32Z and 00:32Z — the hourly Meta→CRM spend sync pulled Meta cleanly but its POST to aura-frankie-insurance.vercel.app/api/crm/adstats was rejected by the sandbox egress policy (403, three runs in a row), so nothing reached the CRM. That is the same feed that has kept “cost per booked call” unmeasurable since Aug 27. Add credits, and allowlist the CRM domain for the scheduled task’s environment.

blockers.label: Mary Grossman’s callback day is today — and she is still uncontacted
blockers.detail: Real NV lead, in the inbox since Sep 6, asked for a call ~Sep 11. Two calendar invites now exist (9:30 PM IST confirm, 7:15 AM IST call). Contact is gated by compliance 0/7 and NV licensing — decide call / refer / hold in writing today. Unblock: send the NPN + CA license # or name who may legally dial her.

blockers.label: Compliance 0/7 on day 15 of live consumer dialing
blockers.detail: b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) and b7 (CA producer license #) are the two that block everything downstream. Fifteen days of paid consumer traffic have now arrived against an uncleared gate. Unblock: the two numbers, or a written one-line rule scoping who may be dialed until they clear.

blockers.label: The watchdog cannot hold a correction — it re-raised a cleared false alarm three hours later
blockers.detail: Cleared 14:10Z, re-published identical “check the Google Sheet” alert 17:06Z. Roughly 20 hours of hourly false alerts burned two full diagnoses. Unblock: widen lead-matching to search the whole inbox, not one subject phrase, and persist cleared state between runs.

blockers.label: Claude API org is out of credits — every autonomous lane is at risk
blockers.detail: Access disabled 15:55Z Sep 10, “organization Oraya is out of usage credits.” Same failure mode as Aug 23. Unblock: add credits on the Billing page; until then treat every scheduled agent as unreliable.

blockers.label: Meta→CRM spend sync blocked by network policy, 3 runs in a row
blockers.detail: Meta pull succeeds; POST to the CRM endpoint returns 403 “policy denial” from the sandbox egress allowlist (22:33Z, 23:32Z, 00:32Z). No spend rows upserted, no gates evaluated. Unblock: allowlist aura-frankie-insurance.vercel.app for the scheduled task environment.

blockers.label: Amanda’s welcome email still never fired — and she can only be reached by phone
blockers.detail: Flagged again 04:06Z: her lead reached the CRM, W1 logged success, no welcome email went out, and she declined automated texts. Unblock: fix the W1 send step; her callback is a manual dial (15105204265) and sits behind the same compliance gate.

blockers.label: Booking rate is still 0% and the deciding metric is still unmeasured
blockers.detail: Sep 10 digest: 0 new, 0 booked, 3 SLA-breached, 3 with contact, 3 unbooked, 4 partials, 135 min median reply. With the CRM sync down, cost per booked call remains unevaluable on day 7 of the $200 V2 tranche. Unblock: restore the CRM feed, then judge the tranche on booked calls, not leads.

blockers.label: Old V1 ad still takes most of the spend; meeting ingest 22 days stale
blockers.detail: Meta’s own Sep 10 rows: “honest broker” (V1) $13.54 vs “Gap math new” $3.93 — 78% to the ad the V2 test was meant to replace, though the new creative is at least delivering now. Separately the 00:02Z Sep 11 meeting ingest failed again with no Mac bridge, leaving meeting intel frozen at Aug 20. Unblock: shift budget or call the test; rebuild ingest as a local task.

tasks.lead: Decide Mary Grossman before her window closes — today
tasks.detail: She asked for a call ~Sep 11 and today is Sep 11. Phone +1 805 302 2655, grossmanmary885@gmail.com, lead L-MTQ3VBRQ-BC, in the inbox since Sep 6 under “[Lead 80] Mary Grossman…”. Calendar holds at 9:30 PM IST (confirm her time before 6:45 PM PT) and 7:15 AM IST tomorrow. Decide call / refer / hold and write it down.

tasks.detail: Day 15 of live consumer dialing with the gate at 0/7. These two numbers are what stands between a real NV prospect and a legal call. Send the NPN + CA license # + TX filing status, or write the one-line rule scoping who may be dialed until they clear.

tasks.detail: Day 7 of 10, $72.04 of $200. Meta’s Sep 10 rows show $13.54 to the old V1 “honest broker” against $3.93 to “Gap math new” — the test is mostly funding the thing it was meant to beat. Shift budget to the new creatives or end the test early.
Still disabled from a Meta ad-review rejection since Sep 8. Not spending, not blocking — just sitting unfixed in the ad set.

tasks.lead: Fix the lead-matching step that invented a four-day outage
tasks.detail: The check searched only for “NEW LEAD CAPTURED…”, so Mary’s “[Lead 80] …” email read as a missing lead and alarmed hourly for ~20 hours. Widen the match to the full inbox, and key on lead ID rather than subject text.

tasks.lead: Make a cleared alert stay cleared
tasks.detail: The 17:06Z run re-published the identical “1 of 3 missing, check the Google Sheet” alert three hours after the 14:10Z run cleared it. The watchdog has no memory between runs — persist resolved state so a correction sticks.

tasks.lead: Allowlist the CRM endpoint for the spend sync
tasks.detail: Three consecutive runs (22:33Z, 23:32Z, 00:32Z) pulled Meta fine then hit 403 “policy denial” POSTing to aura-frankie-insurance.vercel.app/api/crm/adstats. Until this clears, no spend rows land and no gates evaluate — which is why cost per booked call is still a blank.
Lead reached the CRM, W1 logged success, no email went out — flagged again at 04:06Z. She declined automated texts, so the fallback is a manual dial. Find the silent failure in the send step.

tasks.lead: Rebuild meeting ingest as a local task
tasks.detail: 00:02Z Sep 11 run failed again with no desktop bridge — nothing read, merged or written. Meeting intel has been frozen at Aug 20 for 22 days. The cloud→Mac bridge is the known cause; move the job local rather than retrying it.

tasks.lead: Publish the Sep 11 AM brief + live page
tasks.detail: Curated from the live sweep, published to the Vercel brief page and dropped as a Gmail draft to both founders.

tasks.lead: Hold the retraction in the record
tasks.detail: Yesterday’s PM brief led with an alert-suppression bug as the cause of the “lost” lead. The 14:10Z watchdog disproved it. Today’s brief carries the correction so the board does not keep chasing a fix for a defect that was never in the funnel.

tasks.lead: Track the two Mary calendar holds to an outcome
tasks.detail: Invites exist for 9:30 PM IST today and 7:15 AM IST tomorrow. Next brief reports whether either was kept, and whether the compliance decision was written down — not just whether the invite fired.

tasks.lead: Watch for the credit blackout cascading
tasks.detail: With the API org at zero, a lane can fire on cron and still write nothing. Verification rule stands: a lane is healthy only if lastRunAt advanced AND its artifact changed.
